sections.text:
[Effects]
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by 4XL.
Target: yourself. Recovers 10 Cost.
Restores 5% of damage dealt as HP.
Ability Power scales with the number of Relic type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of 5XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.

[Activation Rate]
M+
Activation rate scales with the number of Relic type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of L+ (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 5).
